name: WE-308SX

name: TC-11
description: "Time Constant Equalizer.An electrostatic cartridge represented by the MM type is a so-called alternator, in which an electric current flows by the vibration of the cantilever. However, at the same time, this current also generates a load current, which is a braking force against the cantilever. The braking force against the cantilever caused by the change in frequency distorts the frequency characteristics and phase characteristics, making the sound image indefinite and cloudy.The TC-11 is a time-constant equalizer developed to eliminate this braking force in principle. It keeps the output voltage of the cartridge faithful to the RIAA curve, keeps the current constant regardless of the RIAA curve, and makes the phase characteristics accurate.TC-11 is inserted between the player output and the EQ amplifier input.Compatible with most models of MM and IM types of commercially available cartridges.When using the TC-11, we recommend the CX 8003 for the output cord of the player system and the LX series for the line cord between amplifiers."
